approval.instruction: great, add all the proposed tags.
approval.scope: All 23 consolidated candidates, including optional and conditional candidates.

tags.label: route distances and journey times
tags.definition: Measured distances or elapsed journey times between named places along travel routes, including comparative origin-destination references across transport modes.
includes: Sea, river, rail and overland distance matrices.
Route lengths and comparative journey durations from a place to other destinations.
Sea, coastal, river and overland distance matrices.
Direct and via-route mileage comparisons between named endpoints.
Port-to-port sea distances; river inter-port mileages; origin/destination distance matrices; cumulative distances via a named transport corridor, including mixed-mode routes.
Sea and coast port-to-port distances.
Rail, overland or mixed-route distances and route-distance reference matrices.
excludes: Calendar dates, clock-time conversions and time-zone tables.
Ticket fares and freight charges without route-distance or duration measures.
A railway inventory whose principal subject is railway operation rather than comparative access between places.
Total network length or newly constructed mileage without endpoint-distance comparisons.
Fares and freight charges, which use freight-and-transport-costs.
Physical river length without a travel-route subject.
Total national network length or road construction mileage without place-to-place travel distances.
Territorial surface area or physical river length without a navigation/travel-route measure.
Fares and freight charges (freight-and-transport-costs).
Transport fares or freight charges.
Vessel mileage actually travelled as a traffic-output measure.
River length or territorial dimensions without a transport route.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: commodity origins
tags.definition: The geographical distribution of the origins or producing regions of commodities, especially comparative inventories across products or sectors.
includes: Product-to-province and province-to-product origin catalogues.
Producing districts linked to export ports or outward routes as an explicitly organised geographical inventory.
Inventories pairing many commodities with their producing regions.
Mixed crop, animal-product, mineral, timber and manufactured-product origin lists.
Products paired with producing provinces/regions; province-by-product reference lists; geographical origins and associated export gateways when the regional product pattern is substantial.
excludes: A numerical crop, mine or factory production table merely broken down by province.
General economic indicators combining quantitative domains.
A single incidental place name in a commodity table.
A single commodity adequately described by its commodity tag.
Quantitative multi-domain economic barometers, which use economic-indicators.
Trade quantities by origin or destination without a substantive inventory of regional products.
Single-commodity production or trade tables adequately described by their commodity tag.
Broad numerical economic barometers (economic-indicators).
Pure lists of ports or places without product-origin information.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: human body measurements
tags.definition: Measured physical dimensions and proportional characteristics of human bodies and the distributions or typologies constructed from those measurements.
includes: Height, weight and body proportions; cranial/cephalic indices; tables grouping people by measured physical traits, retaining the source's historical categories.
Cephalic indices, head-shape distributions, stature and bodily measurements.
Descriptive physical-type categories explicitly based on anthropometric observations.
excludes: Nationality or ethnic-community labels without physical measurement (nationality-and-ethnicity).
Age and sex distributions alone (age-and-sex).
Nutrition or disease statistics without bodily measurements.
Nationality or ethnicity without physical measurements or bodily-trait classification.
Clinical disease or nutritional status alone.
Endorsement or modern reclassification of the source's racial theories.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: census and survey methods
tags.definition: The organisation, instruments and procedures used to collect census or survey information.
includes: Census questions, blank survey cards, schedules and enumeration forms.
Instructions to enumerators, census-board reporting categories and data-collection procedures.
Survey sample design and the allocation of sampled units by place or stratum.
excludes: Ordinary population, religious or household statistics merely derived from a census or survey.
Legal household registration without a census or survey collection subject.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: public holidays and commemorations
tags.definition: Recognised public holidays and recurring civic or historical commemoration days and the occasions they mark.
includes: Official public holiday and anniversary calendars.
Dates and events commemorated by state or civic observances.
National holidays; civic commemoration days; recurring memorial observances; lists pairing the calendar day with the remembered event.
National commemorative days and statutory holidays.
Calendars listing the occasion being celebrated or remembered.
excludes: General historical event chronologies.
Calendar conversion, era equivalences and time standards without an observance subject.
Astronomical events without a holiday or commemoration.
Calendar/era conversions and time-zone conventions (calendars-and-time).
One-off chronological event lists not organised as recurring observances.
Religious institutions or adherent counts without an observance subject.
Calendar-system equivalences and time zones, which remain calendars-and-time.
A date incidental to an unrelated table.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: legal profession
tags.definition: Lawyers, advocates and other practising legal professionals, including qualification, licensing, registration and professional establishment.
includes: Licensed or certified lawyers and advocates by place.
Legal professional admissions, certificates and practice qualifications.
excludes: Judicial caseload or court establishments alone.
Police and prison personnel.
Professional-school curricula alone, which remain vocational-education or higher-education.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: writing systems and phonetics
tags.definition: Writing systems, orthographic or phonetic notation, pronunciation systems and the representation of speech sounds.
includes: Alphabets, syllabaries and phonetic symbols; consonant and vowel/final inventories; romanisation/transliteration equivalences; spelling or script reforms.
excludes: Language distribution or language of public services without script/sound analysis (languages).
Language teaching programmes or school language curricula alone (language-education).
Military or technical glossaries whose main subject is the named institutions or objects rather than speech sounds.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: real estate
tags.definition: Transactions, market values and rents of land and buildings as property.
includes: Land and building sales, transaction areas and consideration paid.
Urban land lease rents and quoted values or rents of offices, warehouses and residential property.
excludes: Agricultural ownership and tenancy arrangements without a property-market measure: use land-tenure.
Property taxation alone: use land-tax or taxation.
Residential overcrowding, dwelling conditions or housing support without a property-market subject: use housing.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: printing
tags.definition: Printing, lithography, engraving and related reproduction of printed matter, including the establishments providing these services.
includes: Printing and lithographic works, presses and engraving establishments.
Printing capacity, production, personnel, charges and business inventories.
Commercial and mission printing establishments and presses.
Printing, typesetting, lithography and related print-production activity.
excludes: Paper and pulp production without printing.
Lists or circulation of publications without a printing-production or printing-establishment subject.
Publication-title or circulation statistics alone, which use books, newspapers or periodicals.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: professional associations
tags.definition: Organised bodies representing or coordinating members of a learned or licensed profession and their governance, membership or professional activities.
includes: Medical, legal, engineering and similar professional associations.
Professional association committees, officers and membership.
excludes: Commercial chambers and industry associations, which use business-associations.
Worker bargaining organisations, which use trade-unions.
A roster of licensed practitioners without an association, or an institution devoted solely to scientific research.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: demobilisation
tags.definition: The disbandment, reduction or release of armed forces and the organisation or financing of that process.
includes: Troop-disbandment allocations and implementation.
Release and transition measures explicitly tied to military demobilisation.
Troop disbandment plans and costs.
Demobilisation numbers, discharge arrangements and unit reductions.
excludes: Recruitment or mobilisation.
Veterans' continuing benefits or employment when the demobilisation process itself is not the subject.
Routine peacetime force organisation.
Recruitment or conscription into service.
Routine peacetime unit organisation without a release or disbandment subject.
Welfare of former servicemen after discharge without a substantive demobilisation process.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: asbestos
tags.definition: Asbestos as a mineral fibre or industrial material and its extraction, manufacture and commerce.
includes: Asbestos mining and raw fibre; manufactured asbestos articles and output; asbestos-product trade.
excludes: Unspecified non-metallic mineral output without explicit asbestos.
General building material manufacture that does not identify asbestos.
Health effects inferred solely from asbestos production, without health observations.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: mercury
tags.definition: Mercury (quicksilver), its ores and metal, as a mineral resource, extracted product or traded commodity.
includes: Mercury ore and concentrate production.
Quicksilver deposits, output and commodity imports or exports.
excludes: Mercury merely mentioned as an incidental ingredient in a pharmaceutical or chemical inventory.
Mixed mineral production without a substantive mercury component.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: school curricula
tags.definition: Prescribed subjects, courses, lesson hours and credits that organise formal school instruction.
includes: Weekly timetables, course-hour allocations, curriculum requirements and academic credits.
Comparisons of prescribed instruction by grade or school type.
excludes: Enrolment or school counts without instructional content.
Subjects of public lectures without a formal school curriculum.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: domestic service
tags.definition: Paid or otherwise dependent household service performed by servants and the households employing them.
includes: Domestic servants, household employers, servant wages and conditions.
Counts and proportions of households keeping servants.
excludes: Household manufacture: use cottage-industries.
Public service employment or workers serving customers outside private households.
Family composition or budgets without a domestic-service subject.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: native-place associations
tags.definition: Associations and collective institutions organised around a shared town, district or provincial place of origin.
includes: Native-place guilds, provincial associations and huiguan halls.
Their membership, facilities, accommodation, mutual support and finances.
excludes: Merchant or industrial associations organised primarily by business or occupation: use business-associations.
An overseas population count without a native-place association as subject.
Ordinary hotel or dwelling inventories without a native-place institution.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: fish and fish products
tags.definition: Fish and primary or processed fish commodities in commerce, supply and processing when capture or cultivation is not the principal stated activity.
includes: Trade, market supply and commodity values of fish and fishery products.
Fresh, dried, salted and otherwise processed fish products, when the source identifies them.
excludes: Catch, fishing fleets and capture operations: use fishing.
Aquaculture operations alone: use aquaculture.
Whaling and seaweed when their dedicated tags suffice.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: militias and volunteer forces
tags.definition: Organised volunteer, municipal-defence or militia land forces and their units, strength and service.
includes: Volunteer corps and municipal defence forces.
Militia membership, unit organisation, reserves and equipment.
excludes: Every irregular armed group without evidence of militia or volunteer status.
Civilian police, ordinary standing-army personnel and sporting volunteer clubs.
Automatic inference of foreign-garrison rights from a member's nationality.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: diplomatic claims
tags.definition: Compensation, restitution or other claims advanced through relations between states, including claims for losses arising from incidents and their negotiation or settlement.
includes: Foreign nationals' incident-loss claims presented through governments; diplomatic compensation demands; interstate property restitution claims and negotiated settlements.
excludes: Ordinary government loans or debt service.
Private insurance claims or purely domestic civil litigation.
An imposed treaty/war indemnity already adequately covered by indemnities.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: colonies and leased territories
tags.definition: Colonial possessions and formally leased territories as political holdings, including inventories of their status and administering powers.
includes: Lists of foreign possessions grouped by holding power.
Comparisons of colonies and leased territories as geopolitical units.
excludes: Ordinary production or population statistics merely published in a colony.
Urban concession systems in a nominally sovereign state, which use foreign-concessions.
Annexation or protectorate establishment and termination, when annexation-and-protectorates is the precise subject.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: foreign trade
tags.definition: Merchandise exchange across a territory's external trade boundary when treated in aggregate or without a supported single direction.
includes: Combined total imports-and-exports values by port, partner or period.
Explicit foreign-country merchandise trade for which the source does not establish import/export direction.
excludes: Domestic exchange and purely internal customs movements without external-trade evidence.
Cross-border service, income and capital accounts: use the relevant balance-of-payments or services tags.
A direction-specific series adequately described by imports or exports.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: foreign trade relations
tags.definition: The establishment and institutional development of commercial relations between territories or states, considered separately from the quantity or value of trade flows.
includes: First direct trading contacts; establishment or opening of commercial relationships; development of trading partnerships and access arrangements.
excludes: Routine import/export quantities or values with no substantive relationship/history subject.
Diplomatic missions or treaties without a commercial relationship subject.
Treaty-created port privileges already adequately covered by treaty-ports.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.

tags.label: riots and civil unrest
tags.definition: Episodes of collective civil disorder, riots or violent unrest, with documented participants, casualties, damage or official responses.
includes: Riot events and damage or casualties explicitly attributed to them.
Collective disturbances without an established interstate-war or independence-movement purpose.
excludes: Ordinary individual offences.
Military conflict casualties without civil-unrest context.
Peaceful political-party organisation or all ethnic population tables.
tags.approval_note: All proposed tags approved by the user; individual table evidence still requires confidence.
